description: Windows LAN finder + ESC/POS test for thermal printers over TCP 9100 (same dialect as DantSu Android). Includes Find-BisyncPrinters for real TCP subnet discovery.

steps: Unzip on a Windows PC on the same LAN as the printer.
Run Find-BisyncPrinters.cmd to list printers (TCP 9100), paste JSON into Device set up → Import Windows scan.
Or run Test-BisyncPrinter.cmd with a known printer IP to print a test slip.
In Bisync Device set up, bind the printer (SDK escpos-lan-windows), then use Android DantSu on the tablet for production printing.
